sections.title: 一、找出一个与其他发音不同选项的单词
sections.instruction: 选出画线部分发音与其他三个不同的选项。

questions.translation: 找出画线字母发音不同的单词。
questions.explanation: hello、go 和 no 中的字母 o 均发双元音 /əʊ/；而 orange 中的字母 o 发短元音 /ɒ/。故选B。

questions.translation: 找出画线字母发音不同的单词。
questions.explanation: fine, time, nice中的字母i均处于相对开音节中，发双元音/aɪ/；而it中的字母i处于闭音节中，发短元音/ɪ/。故选D。

questions.translation: 找出画线字母发音不同的单词。
questions.explanation: name中的字母a在开音节中发/eɪ/；cat, dad, rabbit中的字母a在闭音节中发/æ/。故选A。

questions.translation: 找出画线字母发音不同的单词。
questions.explanation: desk, bed, pencil中的字母e均发短元音/e/；these中的第一个e发长元音/i:/。故选D。

questions.translation: 找出画线字母发音不同的单词。
questions.explanation: mum, us, under中的字母u均发短元音/ʌ/；ruler中的字母u发长元音/u:/。故选C。

sections.title: 二、连词成句
sections.instruction: 将所给词语连成一句话，注意大小写和标点符号。

questions.translation: 早上好，埃玛。
questions.explanation: Good morning 是日常问候语，后接称呼语Ella，句末用句号。

questions.translation: 你如何向人们打招呼？
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问句结构：特殊疑问词(How) + 助动词(do) + 主语(you) + 动词原形(greet) + 宾语(people)?

questions.translation: 我很好，谢谢你。
questions.explanation: 问候答语固定句型：主谓结构“I'm fine” + 逗号 + 礼貌感谢“thank you”，句末用句号。

questions.prompt: what, schoolbag, in, you, have, do, your, (?)
questions.answer: What do you have in your schoolbag?
questions.translation: 你的书包里有什么？
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问句结构：疑问词(What) + 助动词(do) + 主语(you) + 实义动词(have) + 介词短语地点状语(in your schoolbag)?

questions.translation: 你还能看到其他什么？
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问句结构：疑问代词短语(What else) + 情态动词(can) + 主语(you) + 动词原形(see)?

sections.title: 三、完形填空
sections.instruction: 通读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C 三个选项中，选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
My name is Peter and I'm from London. I'm in Class 2, Grade 7. Miss Li is our Chinese [1]. She is very kind and we [2] her very much. Miss Li is thirty [3] old and her birthday is on December 7th, next Monday. We want to give some presents(礼物) to [4]. I'm good at drawing(画). I want to draw a [5] for her. I think she will like it. Some of my classmates want to [6] flowers(花) and some want to make [7] for her. They want her to [8] many nice flowers and cards on her [9] next Monday morning.

We also want to have a birthday party [10] Miss Li next Monday evening. We can sing, dance and play games with her then.

questions.translation: 李老师是我们的语文老师。
questions.explanation: 根据后文提到Class 2, Grade 7以及学生们为她庆祝生日可知，Miss Li是老师，Chinese teacher意为“语文老师”。故选C。

questions.translation: 她非常和蔼，我们都非常喜爱她。
questions.explanation: 根据前句“She is very kind”可知，李老师很亲切，所以大家都很喜爱她，love意为“爱戴，喜爱”。故选B。

questions.translation: 李老师三十岁了，她的生日在下周一，12月7日。
questions.explanation: 表达年龄“……岁”用固定结构“… years old”。故选C。

questions.translation: 我们想送一些礼物给她。
questions.explanation: 李老师是女性，作介词to的宾语用宾格代词her。故选A。

questions.translation: 我想为她画一幅画。
questions.explanation: 根据前一句“I'm good at drawing(画)”可知，作者擅长画画，所以想画一幅画（draw a picture）。故选C。

questions.translation: 我的一些同学想要买花……
questions.explanation: 作为生日礼物，买花（buy flowers）符合常理和语境。故选C。

questions.translation: ……还有些同学想为她制作贺卡。
questions.explanation: 根据后一句中的“many nice flowers and cards”可知，这里指的是制作卡片（make cards）。故选B。

questions.translation: 他们想让她在下周一早上在讲桌上看到许多漂亮的花和卡片。
questions.explanation: 把礼物放在桌上是为了让老师一进教室就能看到（see）。故选A。

questions.translation: ……在她的讲桌上看到许多漂亮的花和卡片。
questions.explanation: 在教室里，花和卡片通常放在老师的讲桌（desk）上。故选B。

questions.translation: 我们还想在下周一晚上为李老师举办一个生日聚会。
questions.explanation: have a party for sb. 意为“为某人举办聚会”，介词用for。故选C。

sections.title: 四、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的选项中选出最佳选项填入空白处。
sections.passage: Look! This [1] (be) my uncle's farm. It's [2] big farm. You can see many kinds of [3] (animal). He [4] (have) pigs, horses, cows, ducks, sheep and [5] (chicken). How many ducks [6] (do) my uncle have? Let me count. One, two, three, four, five...fourteen ducks! Oh, no. Look there! Another duck is [7] the big tree. Do you see [8] (those) red house? That's my [9] (uncle) home. It's beautiful. Do you [10] (likes) my uncle's farm?

questions.translation: 看！这是我叔叔的农场。
questions.explanation: 指示代词This作主语，be动词用单数is。故选A。

questions.translation: 它是一个大农场。
questions.explanation: farm是可数名词单数，且形容词big以辅音音素开头，表示“一个”用不定冠词a。故选A。

questions.translation: 你可以看到很多种动物。
questions.explanation: many kinds of 意为“许多种类的”，后面接可数名词复数形式 animals。故选A。

questions.translation: 他有猪、马、牛、鸭子、绵羊和小鸡。
questions.explanation: 主语He是第三人称单数，且句子描述目前农场事实，谓语动词用三单形式has。故选A。

questions.translation: ……鸭子、绵羊和小鸡。
questions.explanation: 与前面的pigs, horses, cows, ducks等并列，此处chicken表示小鸡（可数名词），应用复数形式chickens。故选A。

questions.translation: 我叔叔有多少只鸭子？
questions.explanation: 主语my uncle是第三人称单数，在一般现在时的疑问句中，助动词应用does。故选A。

questions.translation: 另一只鸭子在大树底下。
questions.explanation: under the big tree 意为“在大树底下”，介词under符合方位语境。故选A。

questions.translation: 你看到那座红色的房子了吗？
questions.explanation: 修饰单数名词短语red house，且指示较远处的事物，应用指示代词that。故选A。

questions.translation: 那是我叔叔的家。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词home，表示“叔叔的”，应用名词所有格uncle's。故选A。

questions.translation: 你喜欢我叔叔的农场吗？
questions.explanation: 在含有助动词Do的一般疑问句中，后面的实义动词用原形like。故选A。

sections.title: 五、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage: My friend Jane is a sports fan(爱好者). She has a great sports collection. She has three soccer balls, five baseballs, six volleyballs and two basketballs. They are all under her bed. Jane plays basketball very well. She likes Tom, her classmate. She thinks he is the best (最好的) basketball player in her school. Jane plays baseball very well, too. Now she is in her school baseball club.

questions.translation: 简有六个排球。
questions.explanation: 根据文中“She has three soccer balls, five baseballs, six volleyballs and two basketballs.”可知，简有六个排球。故选A。

questions.translation: 汤姆是一名篮球运动员。
questions.explanation: 根据文中“She likes Tom, her classmate. She thinks he is the best basketball player in her school.”可知，汤姆是一名篮球选手。故选B。

questions.translation: 简篮球和棒球都打得很好。
questions.explanation: 根据文中“Jane plays basketball very well.”以及“Jane plays baseball very well, too.”可知，她擅长篮球和棒球。故选C。

questions.translation: 简是一个体育迷。
questions.explanation: 根据第一句“My friend Jane is a sports fan(爱好者).”可知，简是一个体育爱好者。故选C。

questions.prompt: 5. We can find ______ under Jane's bed.
questions.translation: 我们在简的床下可以找到丰富的体育用品收藏。
questions.explanation: 根据文中提到她有丰富的体育收藏以及“They are all under her bed.”可知，床底下是她的体育用品收藏。故选D。

sections.title: 六、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage: Hello! My name is Jenny Miller. I'm a middle school student. Tom Brown and Linda Smith are my good friends. Linda Smith is English. She is 12 years old (岁). Her English is very good. Tom is English, too. He is 11 years old. He is in China now. His favourite(最喜爱的)colour is black. His cup, jacket and pen are black. He has a telephone. And the phone number is 023-78956. Do you want to be our friend?

questions.translation: 珍妮的姓氏是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据“Hello! My name is Jenny Miller.”可知，Jenny是名字，Miller是姓氏（last name）。故选B。

questions.prompt: 7. Is Jenny a student or a teacher?
questions.translation: 珍妮是一名学生还是一名老师？
questions.explanation: 根据“I'm a middle school student.”可知，珍妮是一名中学生。选择疑问句直接回答选择项。故选A。

questions.translation: 琳达12岁。
questions.explanation: 根据“Linda Smith is English. She is 12 years old (岁).”可知，琳达12岁。故选B。

questions.translation: 汤姆的茶杯是什么颜色的？
questions.explanation: 根据“His favourite colour is black. His cup, jacket and pen are black.”可知，茶杯是黑色的。故选C。

questions.translation: 汤姆的电话号码是多少？
questions.explanation: 根据“And the phone number is 023-78956.”可知电话号码为023-78956。故选A。

sections.title: 七、阅读与表达
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，根据短文内容选择最佳答案。
sections.passage:
Hi. I am a pencil box. I am blue. I am the house of two pencils and three pens. Oh! Two rulers and an eraser are here, too. They are good friends.
I have good friends, too. A pencil sharpener(卷笔刀) and some books are my good friends. We are in a black schoolbag. Our owner is a nice girl. Her name is Linda. She takes us to school every day. She is kind(善良的) to us.

questions.prompt: 1. What colour is the pencil box?
questions.translation: 文具盒是什么颜色的？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段中的“Hi. I am a pencil box. I am blue.”可知，文具盒是蓝色的。故选A。

questions.prompt: 2. How many pens are there in the pencil box?
questions.translation: 文具盒里有多少支钢笔？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段中的“I am the house of two pencils and three pens.”可知，文具盒里有三支钢笔。故选A。

questions.translation: 它们的主人是谁？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段中的“Our owner is a nice girl. Her name is Linda.”可知，它们的主人是琳达（Linda）。故选A。

questions.translation: 琳达为人怎么样？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段中的“Our owner is a nice girl. ... She is kind(善良的) to us.”可知，琳达很善良友好。故选A。

questions.prompt: 5. What are in your pencil box? What colour are they?
options: A ruler and two pens. They are red.
A soccer ball. It is black and white.
questions.translation: 你的文具盒里有什么？它们是什么颜色的？
questions.explanation: 根据常识与问句问及文具盒中的文具及颜色，A项“一把尺子和两支钢笔，它们是红色的”符合文具类别与语法要求。故选A。
